front.transcription:
CHANGE ALIAS
In a city with a safehouse, open your passport to a different page.

A SECOND ALIAS

“We got you some new aliases. Congratulations, you’ve just been hired by an international construction and renovation firm. Shame though; I hear they pay next to nothin’.”

RIGHT NOW
1 Put the 12 enclosed Action tokens by the side of the board to form a supply.
2 Add the enclosed Cover Occupation stickers and Specialization (Transport Crew) stickers to the second alias (the one with the 🌐) of each of the 4 passports.
3 Use disguises to modify these new aliases.
4 Give each of the second aliases a name.
5 Add the new stickers to the rules and Reference cards.
front.flavor: “We got you some new aliases. Congratulations, you’ve just been hired by an international construction and renovation firm. Shame though; I hear they pay next to nothin’.”

front.transcription:
TRANSPORT CREW:
On your turn, whenever you move to a new city, you may move any teams in your city with you.

A WATCHFUL SKY

“The satellites above will observe your movements; your aliases could be compromised if you are not cautious.”

RIGHT NOW
1 Put the 5 enclosed Satellite tokens to the side of the board to form a supply.
2 Add the 12 enclosed Disease cubes to the supply.
3 Set the enclosed Satellite cards to the side for now. You’ll use them during setup.
4 Add the enclosed stickers to the rulebook.
front.flavor: “The satellites above will observe your movements; your aliases could be compromised if you are not cautious.”

front.transcription:
ADD SATELLITE CARDS TO THE PILES:
RULE D
a. Take the Satellite card for each region that has at least 1 Control Center sticker. (Return the other Satellite cards to the reserve.)
b. Shuffle these Satellite cards.
c. Shuffle 1 Satellite card into each Player card pile, starting from the right. If you have fewer than 5 Satellite cards, not all piles will have one. (Satellites appear toward the bottom of the deck.)
d. If you have a 6th Satellite card, put it into the reserve without looking at it.

SATELLITE CARDS
RULE W
When you draw a Satellite card, put a Satellite token in the matching region, then discard the card.
Each city in this region has +1 surveillance (👁) while the satellite token is in it (to a maximum of 3).
If you draw a Satellite card and an Escalation card at the same time, resolve the Satellite card first.
